items.prompt: Create a premium square social media advertisement (1:1) for the watch brand ARVEN. Image 1 is the product: keep the watch EXACTLY as in the photo, seen from the SAME three-quarter angle and viewpoint (same steel case, black dial with three silver sub-dials and their numbers, numbered bezel, crown and pushers, brown leather strap with dark stitching); do not redraw it from another angle, do not add any text or logo on it. Image 2 is the brand logo: reproduce its dial emblem and the name ARVEN faithfully and small in the top left corner, in ivory, without changing the letters. Scene: a writer's desk at dusk — the watch lying on a dark walnut wood desk next to a closed brown leather notebook and a black fountain pen, warm pool of light from a brass desk lamp out of frame, deep shadows, cosy and refined. Typography in ivory (#F3EFE7): at the bottom left a serif headline "Le goût du détail."; under it a small cognac (#A0612B) rectangular button with the ivory text "Voir le chronographe". Spell every word EXACTLY with the accents. No price, no other text, no people, no hands, no wrist.

Image 1 is the product: keep the watch EXACTLY as in the photo, seen from the SAME three-quarter angle and viewpoint (same steel case, black dial with three silver sub-dials and their numbers, numbered bezel, crown and pushers, brown leather strap with dark stitching); do not redraw it from another angle, do not add any text or logo on it. Image 2 is the brand logo: reproduce its dial emblem and the name ARVEN faithfully, small, centered at the bottom, in near-black, without changing the letters. Scene: a flat studio background split vertically in two solid color fields — ivory (#F3EFE7) on the left, cognac (#A0612B) on the right — the watch placed exactly across the dividing line with a soft realistic drop shadow, clean product lighting. Typography: at the top, three short words stacked on three lines in a large bold near-black (#111214) condensed sans-serif: "Acier." then "Cuir." then "Caractère.". Spell every word EXACTLY with the accent on è. No button, no price, no other text, no people, no hands, no wrist.
